source: Lets build a 3d game that is a arcade where the user can choose from a few arcade games to play from a menu then use a first person camera from afar to be able to play the game thru UI buttons watching the 3d model of the arcade game. First lets start with an pinball machine and build the game from there. This should feel as realistic as possible.

answers.ask: Do you walk around the arcade to reach a machine, or does choosing from the menu put you straight in front of it?
answers.answer: Choosing the pinball game from the menu should place the player straight in front of its machine; no walking is needed for this first build.

answers.ask: How many cabinets should the room hold, and should the others be playable later or just set dressing?
answers.answer: Keep the room small with the single playable pinball machine for now; additional arcade cabinets can be simple set dressing and are not playable in this build.

answers.ask: Is this a single room, or an arcade floor you move through?
answers.answer: Make it a single small arcade room, since the player selects the game from a menu rather than moving through an arcade floor.

- [scale] Is this a single room, or an arcade floor you move through? Make it a single small arcade room, since the player selects the game from a menu rather than moving through an arcade floor.
config.genre_evidence: The player "choose[s] from a few arcade games to play from a menu" and is "place[d]... straight in front of its machine; no walking is needed." The layout is a small arcade display/selection room centered on viewing and using a 3D pinball cabinet through UI, rather than a pinball playfield itself.
config.evidence: "Make it a single small arcade room" and "the player selects the game from a menu rather than moving through an arcade floor."
config.addendum:
LAYOUT FEATURES for this Entertainment (Showcase & Hub) map. Build these as the actual structure of the space rather than as set dressing, keep them visually distinct from one another, and keep the whole layout legible in one view.

SHAPE OF THE SPACE - Single Interior: One enclosed building, room or venue that is the entire map — the player never steps outside, so there is no exterior to generate and no transition to link.

INCLUDE:
- Photo Vignette: Well-composed spots distinct from the hero build, made specifically to look good in player screenshots.
- Graphics-Scaling Set Piece: High-fidelity detail clusters — particles, reflections, dense foliage — isolated from the main route so they can be streamed or toggled without hurting performance elsewhere.
- Gathering Area: An open space where visitors congregate rather than move through.
